svg.title: Snowy Friends — step 4: Add ears, a face and texture
svg.desc: Shape long rabbit ears, pointed cat ears or round bear ears with broad bases and grown-up help. Mice can have small flat pebble ears, a carrot-tip nose and grass whiskers. Press each pebble partly into the snow so it stays steady. Fallen leaves can make pointed cat ears. Use stone eyes or shallow carved features. A blunt twig can mark a turtle shell or a cat face.
